`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and stores a flattened snapshot parameter, but never converts `sns` itself from the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. It therefore still passes MultiIndex snapshots to the variable and constraint builders when `"flat"` is selected (including `"auto"` under v1 semantics); the component-data context does not change those arguments. This violates the criterion regardless of the transmission-loss setting.
